# Calculate ELSA scores

Calculating the Entropy-based Local indicator of Spatial Association
(ELSA) scores, which consist of Ea, Ec and the overall ELSA. Requires
the suggested packages sp, spdep and elsa.

## Usage

``` r
ELSA(labels, location, k = 10)
```

## Arguments

- labels:

  Cluster labels.

- location:

  A numerical matrix containing the location information, with rows as
  samples and columns as location dimensions.

- k:

  Number of nearest neighbors.

## Value

A dataframe containing the Ea, Ec and ELSA for all samples in the
dataset.

## References

Naimi, Babak, et al., 2019; 10.1016/j.spasta.2018.10.001

## Examples

``` r
data(sp_toys)
data <- sp_toys
ELSA(data$label, data[,c("x", "y")], k=6)
```
